SESSION	create temporary view t1(c1, c2) as values (0, 1), (1, 2)
SESSION	create temporary view t2(c1, c2) as values (0, 2), (0, 3)
SESSION	create temporary view t3(c1, c2) as values (0, 3), (1, 4), (2, 5)
READ	select * from t1 where c1 in (select count(*) + 1 from t2 where t2.c1 = t1.c1)
READ	select *, c1 in (select count(*) + 1 from t2 where t2.c1 = t1.c1)
READ	select *, c1 not in (select count(*) + 1 from t2 where t2.c1 = t1.c1)
READ	select * from t1 where
READ	select * from t1 where
READ	select * from t1 where c1 in (select 1 from t2 where t2.c1 = t1.c1 having count(*) = 0)
READ	select * from t1 where c1 not in (select 1 from t2 where t2.c1 = t1.c1 having count(*) = 0)
READ	select * from t1 where c1 in (select count(*) from t1 join t3 using (c1) where t3.c1 = t1.c2)
READ	select * from t1 where c1 not in (select count(*) + 1 from t1 join t3 using (c1) where t3.c1 = t1.c2)
SESSION	set spark.sql.optimizer.decorrelateExistsSubqueryLegacyIncorrectCountHandling.enabled = true
READ	select * from t1 where c1 in (select count(*) + 1 from t2 where t2.c1 = t1.c1)
READ	select *, c1 in (select count(*) + 1 from t2 where t2.c1 = t1.c1)
READ	select *, c1 not in (select count(*) + 1 from t2 where t2.c1 = t1.c1)
READ	select * from t1 where c1 in (select 1 from t2 where t2.c1 = t1.c1 having count(*) = 0)
READ	select * from t1 where c1 not in (select 1 from t2 where t2.c1 = t1.c1 having count(*) = 0)
READ	select * from t1 where c1 in (select count(*) from t1 join t3 using (c1) where t3.c1 = t1.c2)
READ	select * from t1 where c1 not in (select count(*) + 1 from t1 join t3 using (c1) where t3.c1 = t1.c2)
SESSION	set spark.sql.optimizer.decorrelateExistsSubqueryLegacyIncorrectCountHandling.enabled = false
